component.name: TM02 Link
component.summary: Send and receive NC programs for an EMCOTRONIC TM02

description.p: Transfers NC programs between a PC and an EMCO lathe with an EMCOTRONIC TM02 control over RS232.

ul.li: Sends programs exported from WinCAM, adding the %NNNN start line the control expects
Shows exactly what will be sent and asks before sending
Receives one program or several, strips the control's padding and keeps each program separately
Port settings for D00 and O91, live CTS/DSR/CD lines and a cable loopback test
